name: @arcanea/claw
description: 5 AI engines (Media, Forge, Herald, Scout, Scribe) with 33 skills, cross-claw event pipeline, Maestro orchestrator. MCP-native, container-first.
long_description: The Claw Fleet is a self-orchestrating AI operations engine for creators. Media Claw scans, classifies, and scores art using TASTE (5-dimension aesthetic evaluation via Gemini Vision). Forge Claw generates, composes, and mints NFTs. Herald Claw manages social media presence with AI-drafted content. Scout Claw monitors markets and competitors. Scribe Claw auto-generates changelogs, blogs, and newsletters. All 5 claws share a Supabase brain and trigger each other through cross-claw events. Maestro evaluates declarative YAML strategies to orchestrate multi-claw workflows.

changelog.0.1.0: Initial release: 8 skills, 11 MCP tools, OpenClaw/NanoClaw/Claude Code support
changelog.0.3.0: Claw Fleet: 5 engines, 33 skills, Maestro orchestrator, security hardening, LLM abstraction
